page.layout: One page of text, running head and page number at top; main text in one block, ending with the closing "Amen."; a woodcut ornament below the text (not transcribed); the catchword and signature at the foot right. Show-through text in the lower half is ignored.

main_text.p: si[?], ne impatientia victi, contra officium ruamus, neve spiritum, arrhabonem nostrum aliqua ratione contristemus: Ecclesiæ vulnera, concordiæ & pacis vinculo colligari: veritatis causa passim sub crucis mole suspirantium gemitus exaudiri: pios Ecclesiæ nutritios, Magistratus ac principes, & in his Illustrissimum nostrum Principem Dn. IOHANNEM CASIMIRUM, &c. veritatis cœlestis πνεύμαχον[?] constantem & syncerum Sancti Spiritus robore & consiliis patriæ ac Ecclesiæ salutaribus clementer instrui: ad laudem & gloriam æterni Dei, Patris, Filii & Spiritus Sancti, qui est unus verus & æternus Deus in secula, Amen.

page.notes: The first word of the page is partly cut off at the left edge; "si" is a likely reading, marked [?]. The Greek word after "cœlestis" is hard to read; the reading πνεύμαχον is a guess from the glyphs and should be checked against the scan. Faint show-through text in the lower half of the page is not transcribed. The woodcut ornament below the text is not text.
